app.instructions:
Select an EPS file in Finder and press Space. Thumbnails are also available in icon view.

If no preview appears, search System Settings for Extensions or Quick Look and enable the EPS Finder extensions.

Files are processed locally; the original EPS is not modified.

installer.welcome.title: EPS previews in Finder
installer.welcome.description: Preview EPS files with the Space bar and see thumbnails in Finder.
installer.requirements: Requires macOS 13 or later. The same package supports Intel and Apple Silicon.
installer.readme.title: Installation and first use
installer.location: EPS Finder will be installed in /Applications/EPS Finder.app. Administrator approval is required.
installer.dependencies: Ghostscript is included. You do not need to install Homebrew or any additional runtime.
installer.firstUse: After installation, open EPS Finder and click “Show sample file”. Select the sample in Finder and press Space.
installer.extensions: If previews are unavailable, search System Settings for Extensions or Quick Look and enable the EPS Finder extensions. Enable icon previews in Finder’s view options for thumbnails.
installer.unsigned: This package is not Developer ID signed or notarized by Apple. macOS may request your approval before opening it.
installer.privacy: EPS processing is local. Your original files are not modified or uploaded. The app connects to GitHub to check for and download updates; automatic checks can be disabled.
installer.license: EPS Finder and Ghostscript are distributed under AGPLv3. The release includes the complete source archive.
installer.conclusion.title: Ready to preview EPS files
installer.conclusion.body: Open EPS Finder from Applications to try the sample. For your own files, select an EPS in Finder and press Space. If needed, enable the EPS Finder Quick Look extensions in System Settings.
installer.component.title: EPS Finder previews
update.idle: Updates are verified and installed in this app. macOS may ask for administrator approval. EPS Finder restarts when the update is complete.
installer.updates: EPS Finder checks for updates at each launch when enabled. Use Check for Updates, then Install Update and Install and Relaunch. Signed updates are verified and installed inside the app; administrator approval may be required.
startup.automatic: Start EPS Finder when I log in
startup.enabled: Starts at login. Update checks also run at every app launch when enabled.
startup.approval: Allow EPS Finder in System Settings → General → Login Items.
startup.installFirst: Install EPS Finder in Applications to enable startup at login.
startup.failed: Could not change startup settings. Check Login Items in System Settings and try again.
setup.cleanupFailed: Some older copies could not be moved to Trash. Remove older EPS Finder copies from Applications manually.
installer.startup: After installation, EPS Finder is registered to open at login and check for updates. You can change both options in the app. macOS may require approval in Login Items settings.
installer.cleanup: The installed app replaces the previous version in /Applications. Older EPS Finder copies in Applications and your personal Applications folder are moved to Trash. EPS documents are not touched.
update.releaseNotes: EPS Finder 1.4.1: EPS thumbnails and Quick Look previews in Finder, signed in-app updates, automatic startup at login and support for English, Turkish, German, French and Spanish.
